derivation:
by
  exact RestrictedProduct.mapAlong_continuous G H id tendsto_id
    (fun i ↦ (φ i : G i → H i)) (hφ.mono fun _ hi ↦ hi.mapsTo) hcont
explanation: Specialize the index map to id, both filters to cofinite, and the coordinate functions to φ. The resulting map is definitionally the forward restricted-product equivalence. The current proof uses this declaration through continuous_restrictedProductMap.
